 Ameren offers $10M in energy bill assistance 
 By Imani McClay Published : Oct. 19, 2026 at 6:48 PM CDT | Updated : 15 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google ILLINOIS ( 25News Now ) - Ameren is offering $10 million in additional funding for programs across Illinois and Missouri to help customers struggling to pay their energy bills as colder weather approaches.
 The company is putting $5 million of that $10 million toward assistance programs across Illinois.
 How the programs work 
 Eligible households can receive up to $500 through the Warm Neighbors Cool Friends program, which matches previous bill payments.
 Small businesses and nonprofits could get up to $1,000, while eligible military members and veterans can receive $400.
 These programs are separate from LIHEAP, meaning customers may qualify for both.
 Ameren urges customers to ask for help early 
 Ameren says customers should not wait to ask for help.
 “My advice is if you’re having some trouble keeping up with your bills to contact us now and not to wait. There are other options outside of energy assistance programs that we may be able to offer to help manage that bill,” said Kim Bond, manager of energy assistance, Ameren Illinois.
 Customers can apply online through Ameren Illinois’ energy assistance page or call the company. Funding is available on a first-come, first-served basis. Ameren says even customers facing disconnection may qualify for help.
